porch.copy: Open the Official U.S. FOIA portal (https://www.foia.gov/) for process / agency contacts. For released/declassified docs only, use the Official CIA Electronic Reading Room (https://www.cia.gov/readingroom/) — outbound links; we never re-host files. Then come back: which nest (Sources / FOIA / History / Speculation / CIA history…), one citation or a clear SPECULATION label, and one question for the room.
